TRANSPARENCY

Numbers, not names.

This board updates live and shows aggregate figures and student handles — how many attended, at which centres, and how participation is trending. A child's record never appears here. A name or photograph appears only where a parent or guardian has consented to it, and disappears the moment that consent is withdrawn. It's how we stay accountable to parents, partners and the community without compromising a single child's privacy.

A student is named or pictured on this page only where a parent or guardian has given consent for it. Consent can be withdrawn at any time, and the board stops showing them on its next refresh. To withdraw it, contact us and we will action it the same day.
